test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Each of the digits in the number 8132475 is arranged in descending order from left to right. what will be the sum of the digits which are third from the left and second from the right in the new number thus formed?
solution:
Given Number → 8132475

Arrangement of digits in the number in decreasing order from left to right:-

(Left) 8132475 (Right) → (Left) 8754321 (Right) 

Third digit from the left in the newly formed number [(Left) 8754321 (Right)] → 5

Second digit from the right in the newly formed number [(Left) 8754321 (Right)] → 2

Sum of third digit from left and second digit from the right in the new formed number → 5 + 2 = 7

Hence, the correct answer is **"7".**
